trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
- **v2.3.1** (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an **18% error rate**.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production (the only other candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was unhealthy in staging).
- Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
- Post-rollback verification: service is **healthy**, error rate dropped to **~0.2%**.

**Incident:**
- The initial incident creation call timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key (guaranteeing at-most-once execution).
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001**, on-call has been paged, with a full description of the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and post-rollback status.
